summary: Created new skill for OCR-based data enrichment workflows. The trace shows extracting claim codes from images and merging with a roster CSV (left-join pattern). This is a distinct reusable capability from pure OCR extraction: it handles reference data lookups, flexible field name matching (CLAIM CODE vs CLAIM REF), and preserving orphan records. The skill complements the existing ocr-data-extraction skill by adding the merge/enrichment layer.
